entry.name: suckah
entry.digest: Get a pixel from the display
entry.description: Creates a click-able area that returns an RGB color, or can accept any screen coordinates to get the RGB values of that pixel.

attributes.name: boundmode
attributes.digest: Constrain Output to Object Bounds
attributes.description: When enabled, theobject will only output color values within the bounds of the object's box. Coordinates outside of the object's bounds will be ignored.

messages.name: (mouse)
messages.digest: Report a color beneath the object
messages.description: Clicking on theobject causes it to report the color of the pixel at the current mouse position to be reported in RGB format (i.e., as a list of three ints).

messages.name: list
messages.description: A list of two integers specifying x and y offset values from the upper left corner of the screen will cause theobject to report the color at the specified screen location in RGB format.
